title: ocotea alnifolia
intro: Ocotea alnifolia, commonly known as Sandalo, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Ocotea alnifolia, including beta-caryophyllene, eudesmol, and ocoteanol, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects. The plant's essential oil has been used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and reduce muscle tension.
